about: A young girl named Koa lives on a small island in the southern archipelago of Mara with her best friend Napopo.
One day, she receives a telegram from her friend Mayo asking for help. After reading the message, Koa learned that there was an emergency and quickly boarded a ship and headed for Mayo.

When she meets Mayo, Koa learns that five pirates of Mara have ravaged the island of Qälis, where many of their friends live, and that they have set up the “the trials of the pirates.” To restore Qälis, Koa and Napopo decides to take on the challenge.

- Discover “map fragments" scattered by the pirates and explore the islands of Mara, with eight diverse islands awaiting players, including the Koa Island, the Pirates' Fort, the Volcanic Island, and the Great Iceberg.

- Each island is made up of four basic stages, packed with ones that players can enjoy such as stages full of traps, stages where you through with speed, and underwater stages. At the end of each island, pirates are waiting for you as you get to enjoy a heated battle that utilizes the characteristics of each island.

- By collecting hidden items on the stage, you can retrieve items stolen from the city of Qälis and change Koa's attire. You can also collect hidden items and upgrade Koa's boat to get to places you've never been before.
- A pirate race takes place in the middle of the game. Koa will compete with her allies on each island. Once you place first, you'll be able to earn new map shards and travel to some secret islands.
- Difficulty levels include “normal mode” and “relaxed mode." No need for complicated controls or camera work – you can play with peace of mind even if you are new to action games.
summary: A young girl named Koa lives on a small island in the southern archipelago of Mara with her best friend Napopo.
